# Rivell

Rivell is contract review software. It checks each clause against a team's own playbook and returns a redline in Word. A person decides every change.

The person using it approves every playbook entry and decides each finding that needs a call. Accepted changes are written into the original Word file as tracked changes, read back, and checked before the file is offered for download.

Rivell is open source and self-hosted. Contracts and knowledge stay on your own servers.

Pages:
- /: what Rivell does and how a review works
- /technology/: how Rivell reviews a contract
- /demo/: a demo on fictional contracts

Source repository: https://github.com/Shridhar600/Rivell

Rivell assists legal review. It does not give legal advice.
